mcqs.question: Where and when was the 13th India–Sri Lanka naval exercise SLINEX-26 conducted?
mcqs.explanation: SLINEX-26, the 13th India–Sri Lanka naval exercise, was conducted at Visakhapatnam from September 17–21. Toulon was associated with Varuna-2026, while Oskemen and AFS Jodhpur hosted other exercises.

mcqs.question: With reference to KAZIND-2026, which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: KAZIND-2026 was the 9th edition of the India–Kazakhstan exercise.
The exercise was held at Oskemen from September 28 to October 11.
The exercise involved 45 personnel from each side.
The exercise focused on counter-terrorism and involved the Garhwal Rifles.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that 45 personnel participated from each side; KAZIND-2026 involved 60 personnel from each side. The exercise was the 9th edition, took place at Oskemen from September 28 to October 11, and focused on counter-terrorism.

mcqs.question:
With reference to Tarang Shakti-2026, consider the following statements:
Statement A: The first edition of Tarang Shakti was held in 2025.
Statement B: The exercise involved aircraft from 8 countries and 32 observers.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because the first edition of Tarang Shakti was held in 2024. Statement B is true: Tarang Shakti-2026 involved aircraft from 8 countries and 32 observers.
